title: Observing complementary Lucas sequences using non-Hermitian zero modes
summary: The Lucas sequences are integers defined by a homogeneous recurrence relation. They include the well-known Fibonacci numbers, which appear abundantly in nature. The complementary Lucas numbers, defined by the same recurrence relation, are less well-known. In this work, we show that such complementary Lucas sequences can be observed simultaneously on the same physical platform, using zero modes in one-dimensional system(s) coupled to a non-Hermitian reservoir.
